name: VLA policy: SmolVLA (SigLIP-style vision, SmolLM2 prefill, flow-matching expert)

provenance.model_version: hub sha 5e8d12a6e2975b0e5e5fce7c8caf47c371d257b6; VLM hub sha 4cde9d208e19519c36917aa170fffc7e381aa0ad; lerobot smolvla source as of fetch date
provenance.notes: Vision tower + connector: onnx_graph_walk of the real architecture built from the real config with random init (719 ONNX nodes -> 331 ops per camera, 107.66 GMAC per 512x512 image, 64 tokens after pixel shuffle x4), run for 2 cameras as lerobot embeds each camera separately. LM prefill and action expert: config_derived from lerobot smolvlm_with_expert.py/modeling_smolvla.py: prefix = 2x64 image + 48 lang + 1 state = 177 tokens; 16 VLM layers (D=960, 15 heads, 5 KV heads, head_dim 64, MLP 2560); expert 16 layers (D=720, MLP 2048), self-attn every 2 layers else cross-attn on the cached VLM K/V re-projected by the expert each step; 10 Euler steps; chunk 50 x 32 (padded) actions. Deployment dtypes are assumptions: int8 weights and linear activations, bf16 attention and KV cache. Parameter cross-check vs safetensors header (500 tensors, total 450,046,176): derived total 450,046,176; group mismatches: none. lm_head is unused at inference. The exported ONNX stores fewer distinct initializers than parameters because the exporter deduplicates identical random-init constants (zero biases, unit norm scales); op bytes_w still counts each use.
references: Shukor et al., SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics, 2025
